business_summary: Beijing Orient EcoEnergy Co., Ltd.engages in the water environment and industrial hazardous waste disposal activities. It is also involved in the research, development, cultivation, marketing, and maintenance of garden plants; and sale of garden machinery and equipment, sporting goods, daily necessities, electronic products, computers, software and auxiliary equipment, handicrafts, toys, stationery and chemical products, rubber and plastic products, and building materials. In addition, the company engages in the environmental landscape garden design; technology development; investment and asset management; automobiles exhaust and flue gas treatment; air pollution, waste gas treatment, water pollution, noise and light pollution, radiation pollution, and solid waste pollution treatment; sports event management; office space rental; market research; exhibitions; and organizational cultural and artistic exchange activities. Further, it provides tree seedlings, flower planting, surveying and mapping services, geological disasters treatment, engineering survey and design, scenic spot management, social and economic consulting, computer system, corporate planning, product design, computer graphic and computer animation design, technical consulting, engineering management services, enterprise management consulting, advertising, and tourist information consultation. Additionally, the company is involved in photovoltaic power generation; develops and constructs new energy power plants. The company was formerly known as Beijing Orient Landscape& Environment Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Beijing Orient EcoEnergy Co., Ltd. in January 2026. Beijing Orient EcoEnergy Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: Beijing Orient EcoEnergy Co., Ltd.는 물 환경 및 산업 유해 폐기물 처리 활동에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 정원 식물의 연구, 개발, 재배, 마케팅 및 유지 관리에도 참여합니다. 정원 기계 및 장비, 스포츠 용품, 일용품, 전자 제품, 컴퓨터, 소프트웨어 및 보조 장비, 수공예품, 장난감, 문구 및 화학 제품, 고무 및 플라스틱 제품, 건축 자재 판매. 또한 회사는 환경 조경 정원 설계에도 참여하고 있습니다. 기술개발; 투자 및 자산 관리; 자동차 배기가스 및 연도가스 처리; 대기 오염, 폐가스 처리, 수질 오염, 소음 및 빛 공해, 방사선 오염 및 고형 폐기물 오염 처리; 스포츠 이벤트 관리; 사무실 공간 임대; 시장 조사; 전시회; 조직의 문화예술교류 활동. 또한 나무 묘목, 꽃 심기, 측량 및 지도 작성 서비스, 지질 재해 처리, 엔지니어링 측량 및 설계, 명승지 관리, 사회 경제 컨설팅, 컴퓨터 시스템, 기업 계획, 제품 디자인, 컴퓨터를 제공합니다.
